name: FAMIERA
recent: FAMIERA 于2025年10月完成IPO并在ACE市场上市，近期宣布以RM5,009,330.08出售一块永久地契土地及建筑物，并宣派第二次中期股息每股RM0.005。公司也发布了截至2026年9月30日止季度的业绩。
notable: 宣派第二次中期单层股息每股RM0.005。
完成首次公开募股并在ACE市场上市，发行1.17亿股新股，发售价每股RM0.25。

recent_en: FAMIERA completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in October 2025. It recently announced the disposal of a freehold land and buildings for RM5,009,330.08 and declared a second interim dividend of RM0.005 per share. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of a freehold land with buildings for a cash consideration of RM5,009,330.08.
Declared a second interim single-tier dividend of RM0.005 per share.
Completed IPO and listed on the ACE Market, issuing 117,000,000 new shares at RM0.25 per share.
